rule_or_requirement: Improve valid completion first and finished lap speed on newly registered matched cells.
observable_information: Current/recent pixel-road centers, private low-visibility count and frozen inherited pixel actions.
allowed_action_or_state_change: During first 20 low-visibility decisions, use stored pixel-road side for +/-0.25 steering; inherit gas and brake.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 20 action changes, zero invalid actions, completion no lower, and on a completion tie median finished lap at least 0.20 s faster or, on exact median tie, P90 at least 0.50 s faster.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on 24 matched fresh TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Lower completion, invalid action, fewer than 20 changed actions, or no predeclared lap distribution improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two pixel arms on tracks 1-3 x fresh TRAIN seeds 5056-5063, 48 episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU comparison capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
